text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Home minister to meet police officers to discuss disco admissions after 12-year-old reported to have taken Ecstasy pill at disco; police say no drugs were found on girl, who suffered effects of drink; discos are prohibited from admitting people under 16.
- Six AIDS deaths this year, highest total since 1986.
- Former Labour prime minister Bonnici on selection panel of Libya's Gaddafi prize for human rights; panel this year awarded prize to U.S. Nation of Islam Leader Louis Farrakhan.
- 547 child abuse cases in last two years.
- Employees demand more talks with Bank of Valletta on new working hours.
